{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''mansion''' was a dwelling built in the surface of an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. The asteroid was kept in a geostationary position in the [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] using one single [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. The insides of the mansion, which included one landing bay, also reflected the bizarre and flamboyant style of the creation.<ref name="G2">{{GamerCite|2|Snow Job}}</ref>

At some point, this mansion was owned by the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan or by one of its agents. The Hutts used the mansion as a part of their cover story for [[Jer Blankuna|Jer]] and [[Gelune Blankuna]]. The Blankunas pretended to be rich entrepreneurs of the shipping business, wanting to hire some resourceful people to find their missing son [[Ree]]. In reality, the Blankunas had no children &mdash; Ree was involved in a plot to seize the control of crime in [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] from the Hutts. The Blankunas provided their new employees with a datapad with information, which also contained a tracker so that [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] mercenaries could find Ree when the independent agents did.<ref name="G2" />

To cut out loose ends, the Hutts moved and renamed the Blankunas as soon as the interview was over, and cleaned out and sold the orbital mansion to Alderaanian [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Jylle Tend]] and [[Sumda Tend|Sumda]].<ref name="G2" />
